subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader guarded PR be the canonical landing path for both the Tavily fallback bug and the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot bug, rather than the narrower Tavily-only PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110?
rationale: Both branches address the Tavily failure, but only this branch also changes shared agent Tool Search runtime-config selection; selecting the permanent landing scope is a maintainer ownership and merge-risk choice rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix
options.body: Accept this PR as canonical after exact-head gates pass, then retire or retarget the narrower Tavily-only branches.

options.title: Split the agent runtime repair
options.body: Keep the guarded Tavily resolver but require the Tool Search runtime-snapshot helper and coverage in a separate focused PR.

options.title: Prefer the Tavily-only branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 only if maintainers intentionally decline the distinct Tool Search snapshot repair in this branch.

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Accept this PR as canonical after exact-head gates pass, then retire or retarget the narrower Tavily-only branches.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment, branch force-push, and authorship of the current squashed head make steipete the clearest owner of the final scope and landing decision.
